We Are Hiring – Senior Specialist – Power BI Developer / Reporting | Abu Dhabi, UAE
🏢 Recruitment Company: Halian  
📍 Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE  
⚡ Availability: Immediate Joiners Only
A leading enterprise environment in Abu Dhabi is looking for an experienced Senior Specialist – Power BI Developer / Reporting.
🔹 Key Technical Skills:
- Power BI Development
- DAX & Power Query
- SQL
- Data Modelling & Semantic Models
- Dashboard Design & Executive Reporting
- Data Integration
- Reporting Governance
- KPI & Management Reporting
🔹 Preferred Experience:
- Large-scale enterprise reporting environments.
- Reporting governance frameworks.
- Risk and compliance reporting.
- Banking and financial services.
⚠️ Important:
- Immediately available candidates ONLY.
- Preference for candidates currently based in the UAE.
📩 How to Apply:
Send your updated CV to:
https://lnkd.in/dztk4v-G
🚫 Do NOT send CVs via LinkedIn DM  
✅ Click on the job link  
✅ Click Apply Now on the website  
📧 You will see the official HR email  
📩 Send your CV directly to the HR email provided.
👉 For fast job updates, join our WhatsApp channel here:
https://lnkd.in/dGnX7Ggc
